llm.note: Analyst assistance only; scoring never uses it.

reason_catalogue.SCORE_BAND_VERY_LOW: The calibrated primary-model score fell in the policy's very low band.
reason_catalogue.SCORE_BAND_LOW: The calibrated primary-model score fell in the policy's low band.
reason_catalogue.SCORE_BAND_MODERATE: The calibrated primary-model score fell in the policy's moderate band.
reason_catalogue.SCORE_BAND_ELEVATED: The calibrated primary-model score fell in the policy's elevated band.
reason_catalogue.SCORE_BAND_HIGH: The calibrated primary-model score fell in the policy's high band.
reason_catalogue.SCORE_BAND_EXTREME: The calibrated primary-model score fell in the policy's extreme band.
reason_catalogue.SECONDARY_MODEL_ELEVATED: The secondary model flagged the event, raising the decision.
reason_catalogue.SEQUENCE_MODEL_ELEVATED: The sequence model flagged the event, raising the decision.
reason_catalogue.ANOMALY_SIGNAL: The anomaly model flagged unusual behaviour, raising the decision.
reason_catalogue.LATE_EVENT: The event arrived late; the policy's late-event minimum applied.
reason_catalogue.BLOCK_NOT_CORROBORATED: A block was not corroborated by a rule or a second model, so the policy sent the case to review instead.
reason_catalogue.STEP_UP_SUCCESS: Step-up authentication succeeded (evidence, not proof of legitimacy).
reason_catalogue.STEP_UP_EXPIRED: The step-up challenge expired before it was answered.
reason_catalogue.STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE: The authentication provider was unavailable (never an allow).
reason_catalogue.ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED: All step-up attempts were used; the case went to manual review.
reason_catalogue.ATO_RESET_NEW_DEVICE_HIGH_VALUE: Password reset and a new device in the last 24 hours, then an unusually high transaction (the classic takeover cash-out).
reason_catalogue.FAILED_LOGIN_BURST: A burst of failed logins on the account (15 minutes) or from the network (1 hour).
reason_catalogue.RAPID_ACCOUNT_CHANGES: Three or more kinds of account change (password, email, phone, MFA, device, address, payment method) within 24 hours.
reason_catalogue.MFA_REMOVED_NEW_DEVICE: MFA was removed in the last 24 hours and the event comes from a new device.
reason_catalogue.ANONYMISED_NETWORK_NEW_DEVICE: A Tor or datacenter network together with a new device. VPN use alone is not matched: it is a signal, not proof.
reason_catalogue.NEW_PAYMENT_NEW_ADDRESS_HIGH_VALUE: A payment method and a delivery address both added in the last 24 hours, with an unusually high amount.
